proposals.before: If armies must be raised and costs mount, then even doubling the levy on traveling merchants and imposing extra taxes on the people of Qi would be justified."
proposals.after: If armies must be raised and costs mount, then even doubling the levy on traveling merchants and imposing extra taxes on the common people would be justified."
proposals.reason: 齊人 here means the common people, not natives of the Qi polity.

proposals.before: If troops are raised and expenses are vast, then even doubling the levy on traveling merchants and adding collections from the people of Qi would be acceptable."
proposals.after: If troops are raised and expenses are vast, then even doubling the levy on traveling merchants and adding collections from the common people would be acceptable."
proposals.reason: Same 齊人 error: commoners, not people of Qi.

proposals.before: Officials' salary silks were usually given at double the rate, but the military commissioner alone was not; Cong gave him the same as the rest.
proposals.after: Officials' salary silks were usually given at double the rate, but the military commissioner alone was not; Cong gave himself the same as the rest.
proposals.reason: 從皆與之同 means Cong treated himself the same; 'gave him' wrongly implies a third party.
Literal doubles the biography-header formula; align with the idiomatic sense.

proposals.before: Neng's nephew Cong's nephew Shenyou — Shenyou, style name Jingzhi.
proposals.after: Neng's nephew Shenyou, style name Jingzhi.
proposals.reason: Literal fuses section header with a doubled name.

proposals.before: Neng's nephew Cong's nephew An Qian — An Qian, style name Jinzhi.
proposals.after: Neng's nephew An Qian, style name Jinzhi.
proposals.reason: Literal fuses section header with a doubled name.

proposals.before: the Qing River is the surname Cui's hope, signifying devouring and swallowing.
proposals.after: Qinghe stands for the Cui clan's ancestral prestige (wang), signifying devouring and swallowing.
proposals.reason: In 清河，崔望也, 望 denotes the clan choronym/ancestral prestige (郡望), not 'hope'; the literal English mistranslates 望.

proposals.before: When Empress Wu heard of this, she released Xi to Lingnan and only demoted Weidao to Prefect of Jizhou.
proposals.after: When Empress Wu heard of this, she banished Xi to Lingnan and only demoted Weidao to Prefect of Jizhou.
proposals.reason: Chinese 放錫嶺南 in this Tang legal context means banishment/exile to Lingnan, not release from custody.

proposals.before: His grandfather Kuan, a grandson by marriage of Emperor Wen of Sui, served as magistrate of Liangquan.
proposals.after: His grandfather Kuan, a maternal grandson of Emperor Wen of Sui, served as magistrate of Liangquan.
proposals.reason: 外孫 means maternal grandson (daughter's son), not grandson by marriage.

proposals.before: His grandfather Kuan was a grandson by marriage of Emperor Wen of Sui and served as magistrate of Liangquan.
proposals.after: His grandfather Kuan was a maternal grandson of Emperor Wen of Sui and served as magistrate of Liangquan.
proposals.reason: 外孫 means maternal grandson (daughter's son), not grandson by marriage.

proposals.before: The Liu brothers of Yazhou were framed for rebellion by attending censor Lai Zixun; Wuzi and Lai Junchen were ordered to try the case together. Junchen accused Wuzi of favoring the prisoners and concealing evidence of rebellion; when Wuzi was later placed under Junchen's jurisdiction as well, he committed suicide.
proposals.after: Prefect of Yazhou Liu Xingshi and his brothers were framed for rebellion by attending censor Lai Zixun; an edict ordered Wuzi and Lai Junchen to try the case together. Junchen accused Wuzi of favoring the prisoners and concealing evidence of rebellion; when Wuzi was later placed under Junchen's jurisdiction as well, he committed suicide.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic omits the named prefect 劉行實 (Liu Xingshi) and the office 雅州刺史 present in the Chinese.

proposals.before: The brothers Liu Xingshi and Liu Xingqi of Yazhou were slandered as rebels by the Attending Censor Lai Zixun; an edict ordered Wuzi and Lai Junchen to try the case jointly. Junchen said Wuzi was friendly with the prisoners and concealed their rebel evidence; later he was ordered to try Wuzi together with them, and Wuzi then killed himself.
proposals.after: Prefect of Yazhou Liu Xingshi and his brothers were slandered as rebels by the Attending Censor Lai Zixun; an edict ordered Wuzi and Lai Junchen to try the case jointly. Junchen said Wuzi was friendly with the prisoners and concealed their rebel evidence; later Junchen was ordered to try Wuzi together with them, and Wuzi then killed himself.
proposals.reason: Literal invents a second personal name Liu Xingqi not present in 劉行實兄弟, and softens 雅州刺史.

proposals.before: Outwardly he seemed careful and thick, but inwardly he was harsh and mean.
proposals.after: Outwardly he seemed careful and generous, but inwardly he was harsh and mean.
proposals.reason: 厚 in 謹厚 means generous/kind, not physical thickness; 'thick' misrenders the character judgment.

proposals.before: Whenever he received orders to interrogate cases, he always washed for dirt and sought flaws; unless the accused entered death he would not stop, and people feared and despised him.
proposals.after: Whenever he received orders to interrogate cases, he always scrubbed for dirt and sought flaws; unless it came to a death sentence he would not stop, and people feared and despised him.
proposals.reason: 澡垢 is figurative scrubbing for faults; 不入死 means he would not stop short of a death sentence, not that the accused 'entered death'.

decisions.reason: In s0018, 加斂齊人 is paired with 倍算商旅 as a fiscal extreme; 齊人 means the common people, not natives of the Qi polity named in s0017’s dynastic list.
The same 齊人 in s0018 is the taxed commons opposite 商旅; ‘people of Qi’ is a mistranslation, and ‘common people’ restores the sense.
After noting that the military commissioner alone lacked doubled salary silk, 從皆與之同 means Cong applied the same rate to himself; ‘gave him’ invents a third-party beneficiary.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 獨節度使則否，從皆與之同

decisions.reason: 曾孫從 is the biography-header formula fused into the unit; the doubled ‘great-grandson Cong’ is an artifact, and ‘His great-grandson was Cong’ matches the Chinese sense.
The unit is header 能從子慎由 fused with 慎由，字敬止; ‘Cong’s nephew’ is not in this Chinese, and the proposed wording restores Neng’s nephew Shenyou with style Jingzhi.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 能從子 慎由慎由，字敬止

decisions.reason: Likewise 能從子安潛安潛，字進之 is header plus body; inventing ‘Cong’s nephew’ and doubling the name is wrong, and the repair is accurate.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 能從子 安潛安潛，字進之

decisions.after: Qinghe stands for the Cui clan's ancestral prestige, signifying devouring and swallowing.
decisions.reason: 清河，崔望也 uses 望 as the Cui clan’s choronym/ancestral prestige, not ‘hope’; the proposal’s sense is right, but the parenthetical ‘(wang)’ is awkward in the finished literal.
放錫嶺南, contrasted with 才降味道集州刺史, is exile of Xi to Lingnan in a Tang legal setting; ‘released’ misreads 放.
隋文帝外孫 identifies Kuan as the emperor’s maternal grandson (daughter’s son); ‘grandson by marriage’ is the wrong kinship.
The same 外孫 requires ‘maternal grandson’ in the literal; the proposed wording corrects the kinship without other change.
雅州刺史劉行實兄弟 names Prefect of Yazhou Liu Xingshi and his brothers, and 詔 marks an edict; the idiomatic omitted the office and personal name.
The Chinese has only 劉行實兄弟, not a second named brother Liu Xingqi, and states 雅州刺史; the repair removes the invented name, restores the office, and clarifies 命俊臣並治.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 雅州刺史劉行實兄弟……後命俊臣並治

decisions.reason: 外若謹厚 contrasts outward careful generosity with inward harshness; 厚 here is generous/kind, not physical ‘thick’.
澡垢索疵 is figurative fault-hunting, and 不入死不肯止 means he would not stop short of a death sentence, not that the accused ‘entered death’.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 必澡垢索疵，不入死不肯止
